snippet.title: Evercade - NEOGEO Arcade 2 and 3 - Trailer
snippet.description:
More NEOGEO Arcade Collections are coming to Evercade! Enjoy twelve more classics from the golden age of pixel art gaming across two Evercade Cartridges! 

NEOGEO Arcade 2 includes GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES, ART OF FIGHTING 2, METAL SLUG 2, CROSSED SWORDS, NINJA COMMANDO and SENGOKU 2.

NEOGEO Arcade 3 includes THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97,  SAMURAI SHODOWN II, METAL SLUG 3, GHOST PILOTS, SUPER SIDEKICKS, and TWINKLE STAR SPRITES!

Release: October 2025
Pre-Order: August 29, 2025

Find out more:
NEOGEO Arcade 2: https://evercade.co.uk/cartridges/neogeo-arcade-2/
NEOGEO Arcade 3: https://evercade.co.uk/cartridges/neogeo-arcade-3/
